data.name: Horizon Hunters Gathering
data.detailed_description:
Rally for the hunt and sign up to upcoming Horizon Hunters Gathering playtests by signing up to the Beta Program at PlayStation.

Find your calling and team up as humanity’s last line of defence against deadly machines in Horizon Hunters Gathering.

SQUAD UP IN THREE-PLAYER TEAMS

Choose from a roster of uniquely skilled Hunters, each with a different playstyle and weapon, and fight in coordinated co-op with friends or alongside NPCs across a wild, post-apocalyptic world. You’ll need to master unique combat, refine your Hunter builds, and strategize together to succeed.

HUNT LETHAL MACHINES TOGETHER

Face off against challenging and deadly machines, with a variety of attacks and elemental effects, in high-intensity missions across different environments and landscapes. With every hunt you embark on, the machines grow stronger, but so do you. Discover new ways to fight through rogue-lite progression, collect perks to further optimize or craft new builds for every hunt, and level up your Hunters’ skill paths to reach their full tactical potential.

FIGHT FOR THE FUTURE OF HUMANKIND

Threatened by corrupted, lethal machines, humanity stands on the brink of annihilation. As a last line of defence, you must join the Gathering as a fearless Hunter and stand united against the rogue AI, HEPHAESTUS. The hunt doesn't end there, though - experience the adventure and the story of this new battle against the machines through an unfolding campaign.

JOIN THE GATHERING

Between missions, return to the Gathering – a safe haven for all tribes – where you can customize your camp, upgrade gear, and forge powerful new allyships to help you face off against the ever-growing machine threat.
